{{Quote|From the looks on your faces I'd advise against perusing the Belascoan Archive Report — my summary of it is, if anything, too gentle. But there were the occasional triumphs amid terror — and Parcovey Minor was one of them.|Albegron speaks about the assault many years later|<ref name="EGTWAC" />}}
During the [[Kymoodon Era]], forces backed by the [[Hutt/Legends|Hutt]] [[Utoradii]] kajidic '''assaulted''' the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Parcovey Minor]] in the hope of [[Slavery/Legends|enslaving]] a group of colonists settled there. Thanks to a tip off the [[Belasco Free Volunteers]] managed to reach the planet and defend it from the raiders, capturing or killing them all. The colonists and volunteers then traveled to [[Affavan]] to take vengeance on the Hutts. A [[Holodrama/Legends|Holodrama]] was made depicting the events of the assault [[Standard century/Legends|centuries]] after it occurred.

==Prelude==
{{Quote|According to the Archive Report, a captured Jilruan pirate told the authorities on Belasco of the planned raid on Parcovey Minor.|Albegron speaks about the assault many years later|<ref name="EGTWAC" />}}
During the [[Kymoodon Era]], the [[Utoradii]] [[Hutt/Legends|Hutt]] [[Kajidic/Legends|kajidic]] backed a number of raids against [[Planet/Legends|planets]] beyond the frontier with the aim of capturing [[Slavery/Legends|slaves]]. A [[Jilruan/Legends|Jilruan]] [[Unidentified Jilruan pirate|pirate]] learned of plans for the next Hutt backed attack which was aimed at capturing a group of [[Nerf/Legends|nerf]] [[Nerf herder/Legends|herding]] colonists on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Parcovey Minor]]. The [[Pirate/Legends|pirate]] was captured however and informed authorities on the planet [[Belasco/Legends|Belasco]] of the upcoming assault, giving the [[Belasco Free Volunteers]] time to mobilise and rush to Parcovey Minor's aid.<ref name="EGTWAC" />

==The assault==
{{Quote|The Belasco Free Volunteers rushed to the colony's defense and were hiding on several ranches when a barque filled with Klatooinian and Weequay raiders attacked.|Albegron speaks about the assault many years later|<ref name="EGTWAC" />}}
The volunteers reached the planet before the Hutt forces and managed to hide in several of the colonists' ranches. When the Hutt forces did arrive they consisted of a barque full of [[Weequay/Legends|Weequay]] and [[Klatooinian/Legends|Klatooinian]] raiders whom the volunteers managed to [[Death/Legends|kill]] or capture all of. The volunteers also captured the [[Starship/Legends|starships]] of the raiders.<ref name="EGTWAC" />

==Aftermath==
{{Quote|So no, Novan Nune never faced Huska the Hutt in single combat. But there really was a tale of triumph involving Parcovey Minor, Republic colonists, and some very surprised Hutts getting what they deserved.|Albegron speaks about the assault many years later|<ref name="EGTWAC" />}}
The defending forces interrogated the raiders and discovered that it was the Utoradii who were behind the attack. Taking the captured starships they traveled to the planet [[Affavan]] where the Hutts expected slaves from the raids to be delivered. There they found the Utoradii at a [[Parlay-feast on Affavan|parlay-feast]] with the [[Vijilakii]] kajidic and took vengeance on the slavers. A report including information about the assault was stored in a [[Kymoodon-era government archive|government archive]] on Belasco following the battle.<ref name="EGTWAC" />

In the [[Standard year/Legends|year]] [[114 BBY]] an episode of the [[Holodrama/Legends|Holodrama]] series ''[[True Tales of the Ancient Republic]]'' was released based loosely on the events surrounding the battle. The episode, titled [[Episode XXIV: Death on the Rim]], depicted the raiders successfully capturing the colonists in the assault only for the [[Sector Ranger/Legends|Sector Ranger]] [[Novan Nune]], a fictional character, to travel to Affavan to save them. In [[6 ABY/Legends|6 ABY]] the Academician of Popular Studies [[Thunys Albegron]] spoke about the differences between the episode and reality at the [[Conference on Popular Entertainment]] on [[Obroa-skai/Legends|Obroa-skai]].<ref name="EGTWAC" />

==Behind the scenes==
The assault was first mentioned in the [[2014]] fifth entry in the ''[[Star Wars: The Essential Guide to Warfare Author's Cut]]'' series of posts by [[Jason Fry]] on the [[StarWars.com]] [[Star Wars Blog|blog]]. The article featured content cut from ''[[The Essential Guide to Warfare]]'' a book released in [[2012]] by Fry.
